Fixture objects can be placed on the floor by dragging them from the inventory to a desired location. A maximum of 40 fixture objects are permanently stored per area. This way you can for example customize the interior furnishings of a house individually. The inventory of a fixture object is NOT saved.

Workstations are special fixture objects that are required to practice a trade.
